    Product Details:

    Digimate Impress 750W Lightweight Dry Iron with Premium German Coating (DG-IG-750W-02-Teal)

    • Product Description
    • Specification
    • Legal Information

    The Digimate impress 750W Dry Iron is designed to deliver smooth, efficient, and hassle-free ironing for everyday use. Equipped with a premium German non-stick coated soleplate, it ensures effortless gliding over all types of fabrics while preventing sticking and damage. Its lightweight build and smart ergonomic design provide a comfortable grip, making long ironing sessions easy and fatigue-free.

    With multiple temperature settings and 6 fabric-specific heat controls, this iron offers precise customization for delicate to heavy fabrics. Safety is enhanced with a built-in thermal fuse and thermostat to protect against overheating. The 360-degree swivel cord allows flexible movement, helping you achieve a flawless finish without tangling. Durable, reliable, and easy to use, the Digimate Impress is an ideal choice for modern homes.

    Features

    • Powerful 750W Performance: The 750W heating element ensures quick heat-up and reliable performance, making daily ironing faster and more efficient.
    • Premium German Non-Stick Coating: High-quality German coating on the soleplate delivers smooth gliding over all fabrics while preventing sticking, ensuring better durability and fabric protection.
    • Lightweight & User-Friendly Design: Its lightweight construction makes the iron easy to maneuver, reducing hand strain and making it ideal for longer usage.
    • Ergonomic Grip for Comfort: The smart ergonomic handle provides a comfortable and firm grip, allowing better control and effortless ironing.
    • 6 Fabric-Specific Heat Settings: Equipped with six preset fabric options, enabling safe and customized ironing for cotton, wool, silk, synthetics, and more.
    • Adjustable Temperature Control: Offers precise control over heat levels, helping you choose the right temperature for different garments.
    • Thermal Fuse Safety Protection: Built-in thermal fuse cuts off power during overheating, ensuring enhanced safety for both the user and the appliance.
    • Inbuilt Thermostat for Consistent Heat: Maintains an even temperature throughout the ironing process, preventing overheating and protecting fabrics.
    • 360° Swivel Cord for Easy Movement: The flexible swivel cord allows smooth, tangle-free movement in any direction for a hassle-free ironing experience.
    • Warranty: 24 Months Manufacturer Warranty
